title: Validate a SaaS Idea Before You Build | GhostTown
headline: Validate your SaaS idea before you spend months building it.
description: Run a free GhostTown verdict on a SaaS idea. Identify the biggest unknown, the fastest real-world test, and what would make the idea worth pursuing.
customerPrompt: Who is the first specific business or user that would pay for this SaaS?
problemPrompt: What recurring, expensive, or frustrating problem does the SaaS remove?
alternativePrompt: What software, spreadsheet, manual process, employee, agency, or workaround do they use now?

title: Validate an AI Startup Idea | GhostTown
headline: Test whether your AI startup solves a problem people will actually pay to remove.
description: Evaluate an AI startup idea against customer pain, alternatives, timing, leverage, and the cheapest commitment test you can run now.
customerPrompt: Who has the painful workflow before the AI exists?
problemPrompt: What measurable job becomes faster, cheaper, safer, or more valuable?
alternativePrompt: What human workflow, incumbent software, consultant, or general AI tool already addresses it?
examples: AI copilots for a specific profession

title: Validate a Local Business Idea | GhostTown
headline: Find out if your local business idea deserves a real-world test.
description: Validate a local business idea by narrowing the first customer, painful problem, current alternative, and fastest low-cost way to test demand.
customerPrompt: Which local customer segment buys first, in what geography?
problemPrompt: What urgent local need, inconvenience, risk, or desired outcome creates willingness to pay?
alternativePrompt: Which existing local provider, DIY option, referral network, or no-action alternative wins today?

title: Validate an Ecommerce Product Idea | GhostTown
headline: Test your ecommerce idea before inventory, ads, and packaging eat the budget.
description: Run a free GhostTown verdict for an ecommerce concept and identify the strongest customer pain, competing alternative, and cheapest purchase-intent test.
customerPrompt: Who wants this enough to switch or buy now?
problemPrompt: What desired outcome or pain makes this product meaningfully better than doing nothing?
alternativePrompt: What product, marketplace listing, brand, DIY solution, or substitute already gets the purchase?

title: Validate a Service Business Idea | GhostTown
headline: Validate the service before you build the agency around it.
description: Test a consulting, agency, freelance, or managed-service idea by identifying a specific buyer, costly problem, existing alternative, and first paid commitment test.
customerPrompt: Which buyer has budget authority and a reason to act now?
problemPrompt: What outcome are they already spending money, time, or reputation to achieve?
alternativePrompt: Do they hire employees, freelancers, agencies, software, or simply tolerate the problem?

title: Validate a Marketplace Idea | GhostTown
headline: Test one side of your marketplace before trying to manufacture liquidity.
description: Evaluate a marketplace idea by isolating the first constrained side, the transaction pain, current alternatives, and a low-cost test of real commitment.
customerPrompt: Which side of the marketplace is hardest to acquire and matters first?
problemPrompt: What transaction, trust, discovery, coordination, or access problem hurts enough to change behavior?
alternativePrompt: Where do buyers and sellers find each other today?

title: Validate an App Idea Before Coding | GhostTown
headline: Before you code the app, test whether anyone needs the outcome.
description: Validate a mobile or web app idea with a GhostTown verdict focused on the first user, painful problem, alternatives, timing, and cheapest evidence-seeking test.
customerPrompt: Who would change an existing habit to use this app?
problemPrompt: What job or pain is important enough to create repeat use?
alternativePrompt: What app, browser workflow, messaging thread, spreadsheet, or offline behavior already works well enough?

title: Validate a Side Hustle Idea | GhostTown
headline: Test the side hustle before it becomes a second unpaid job.
description: Use GhostTown to narrow a side-hustle customer, problem, offer, and fastest test before committing nights, weekends, or meaningful cash.
customerPrompt: Who can you reach without building a large audience first?
problemPrompt: What will they pay to solve instead of merely saying the idea sounds interesting?
alternativePrompt: How do they solve it now, and why would they switch?

title: Should I Build This Business Idea? | GhostTown
headline: Should you build it? First find out what must be true.
description: Turn a business idea into a falsifiable customer, problem, offer, and next test. GhostTown helps you decide what to test before deeper build investment.
customerPrompt: Who specifically must care for this to work?
problemPrompt: What painful problem or desired outcome makes action rational?
alternativePrompt: What wins if your idea never exists?
examples: founder ideas still on the whiteboard

title: Find the Cheapest Test for a Startup Idea | GhostTown
headline: Find the cheapest test that could prove your idea wrong—or earn the next investment.
description: Use GhostTown to identify the biggest unknown in a startup idea and the fastest bounded test of real customer behavior before building more.
customerPrompt: Whose behavior would provide the strongest evidence?
problemPrompt: Which assumption would kill the idea if it is false?
alternativePrompt: What behavior today shows the customer is already trying to solve the problem?
